title: Station Lessons
description: Per-station teaching lesson content for the Demo_Game lesson panel. Loaded at runtime by OpenWorld::TryLoadLessonsFromJSON. See docs/DEMO_GAME.md for the lesson authoring guide.

version.description: SemVer string. Bump the major version on breaking field changes.

_comment.description: Optional free-text comment — ignored by the runtime.

lessons.description: Array of lesson entries, one per teaching station.

stationID.description: Must match a TeachingStation::id registered in C++ or teaching_stations.json.

lessonTitle.description: Short heading shown at the top of the lesson panel (≤ 80 chars recommended).

lessonText.description: Multi-line explanation. Use \n for line breaks. Aim for 5–10 lines.

codePointers.description: File paths / class names the student should inspect. Relative to the repo root.

relatedStations.description: Station IDs that cover related topics. Reserved for future cross-link UI.

challengeTitle.description: Optional: short title for the combo-practice mini-game available at this station. When present together with challengeKeys, the lesson panel shows a [Space] prompt to start the challenge.

challengeKeys.description: Optional: ordered sequence of single-character keys (e.g. ['1','2','3']) the player must press in order to complete the combo challenge. Must be non-empty when challengeTitle is set.
